title: The Shape of a Quiet Morning

values.title: The Shape of a Quiet Morning
values.text: An illustrated journal about paying attention.

values.caption: Light changes the familiar into something worth seeing again.

values.text:
## Begin with what is nearby

A room has its own weather. Light collects on the edge of a table; a small sound briefly interrupts the ordinary. Good notes start here, with something concrete.

Try naming what you can see before deciding what it means.

values.title: In the margin
values.text: Observe first. Interpret second. Leave room for uncertainty.

## A practice of noticing

- Return to one place.
- Record one precise detail.
- Compare it with yesterday.

A repeated observation can become a story.

## A question to carry

What changed while you were looking elsewhere? Keep that question open as you walk home.
A small publication / Written slowly / Issue 01
